sections.text:
[Effects]
Reflects physical and magic damage taken by M.
Reduces physical damage taken by M.
Reduces magic damage taken by M.
Reduces physical Ability Power by 4XL+.
Reduces magic Ability Power by 4XL+.

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Star elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
